android.desc:
Transform your device into a professional stadium LED scrolling scoreboard.
Experience the most exciting and fluid sports ticker at a glance on Android. Whether you are tracking the NFL on Sunday, checking MLB scores, or monitoring the Premier League, LED Sports Ticker delivers real-time data with a premium 120 FPS scrolling engine. Horizontal tablets and phones work great. Cast or mirror it to your TV for a huge electronic billboard! Pinch to zoom. OLED screen and power saving feature dims screen after 5 hours, just touch to resume.
NEW PRO FEATURES: Pick your favorite teams to appear more or get pinned. Tap a game and get a popup showing detailed stats and highlights!
UNRIVALED CELEBRATION ENGINE: 🔥 Automatic Centering: When a team scores, the ticker instantly slides and centers the play so you don't miss a second of the action. 🎆 Fireworks & Effects: High-intensity fireworks burst across your screen to celebrate every touchdown, home run, and goal. 📢 Stadium Sound Experience: Hear the roar of a live crowd and high-impact air horn blasts. ⚡ Flashing Alerts: The scoring team's logo and names flash with high-glow LED brightness during the celebration.
FEATURES: ✅ Real-Time Scores: Live data for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, Soccer (USA & International), NCAA, Tennis, Golf, Cricket, Rugby, Horses, Softball, College sports and Racing (F1, NASCAR). ✅ Winner-First Logic: The leading team is always moved to the left side of the board for an intuitive "Winner's View." ✅ Liquid Smooth Scrolling: Optimized for 120Hz displays. Moves in sub-pixel shifts for zero choppiness, even on large tablets. ✅ Interactive Controls: Touch to stop the ticker; swipe left or right to manually scan the latest results. ✅ High-Fidelity Art: Professional team logos and high-glow LED matrix text effects for an authentic stadium feel. ✅ Weather & Clock: Includes live local weather and time. Perfect for desk docks or charging stands. ✅ Fully Customizable: Adjust scroll speed, LED size, spacing, and league filters to match your setup.
WHY CHOOSE LED SPORTS TICKER? Unlike other apps that jump or show outdated data, our "Complete Loop" logic ensures you see every game in the league before refreshing, with the most stable real-time score tracking available. Great for tablets and phones in horizontal landscape as an art set piece on your desk or in your man cave.
